evidence: Substantially expands the core util::Result utility in src/util/result.h (+399/-62) and associated unit tests.
rationale: The PR extends the util::Result and util::ResultPtr primitives to make them more capable for returning structured error and warning states. Reviewers note this 'makes util::Result quite a bit more powerful, and it\'s still simple to use', offering a cleaner error-handling pattern across multiple subsystems.
